verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: B'eyb'alejek tojolal, aokab' tas wach' tze k'ulej, yujto toxo wal ol ex in koleli. Ol in ch'oxel in poder in kolwaji.

Te wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, sb'eyb'alan heb' icha wal yaji, haton heb' niwan yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ay, max yixtejb'at heb', haton heb' syailan sb'a, max sk'ulej chukal heb', xchi Jehová.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok nacional syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, mokab' yal heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová max in cha'anoch t'a skal schonhab' tik. Hanhejtona' heb' winh malaj yuninal, mokab' yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha in tik lajan in icha junok te' takinh te'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Tato a heb' winh malaj yuninal chi' niwan yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ay, sk'anab'ajan pax heb' winh tas tzin nib'ej, tojol syutej sb'a heb' winh t'a in trato,

ay jun tas te wach' ol wak' t'a heb' winh t'a yichanh to ay yuninal, ma yisil. Ha jun chi', to ol b'inajnhej heb' winh t'a in templo yet' t'a skal in chonhab'. Ol wak'anpax jun sb'i heb' winh t'a junelnhej, malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok.

Haxo pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il syak'och sb'a t'a yol in k'ab', yik tzin yak'an serwil heb', tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'ayin, tzin sxajanej heb', sk'anab'ajan pax sk'ual ik'oj ip heb', tojol syutej sb'a heb' t'a in trato, ol in chaoch heb' t'a skal in chonhab'.

Ol wik'kot heb' t'a jun in tzalan wiknhej yaji. Ol wak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' t'a spatil b'aj tz'och lesal t'ayin. Ol in cha silab' heb' snhustz'a t'a yib'anh waltar, yujto a in templo tik, ol alchaj yuj to spatil lesal yaj t'a masanil chonhab'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in tzin molb'ejkot heb' israel aykanb'at t'a juntzanh ch'ok nacional, a in swala': Ol wik'kot juntzanh heb' ch'ok nacional yik junnhej tz'aj heb' yet' heb' israel molb'ilxo wu'uj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex ch'ok nacional, kotanhek icha nok' chium nok'. Kotanhek milwal, ul satekel in chonhab' tik, icha syak' nok' kaltakte'al nok' sjawi, schianb'at nok' kalnel.

Yujto a heb' stanhwumal in chonhab' tik, ichato maxtzak yal yilan heb', maxtzak nachajel yuj heb' tas sk'ulej. Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' max chiwaji. Jichanek' heb' tzek' k'u. Anhej wayanh snib'ej heb' sk'ulej.
Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' tz'ochnhej swejel, malaj b'ak'inh sb'ut'ji. Ha heb' yilumal in chonhab' tik, max nachajel jab'ok yuj heb', anhej tas snib'ej heb' sayek'i.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Koyek b'at ko sayek anh anh, a anh te ow skuk'ejek, yik sk'e wal anh t'a ko jolom. Skuk'anpax anh k'ik'an icha sko k'ulej tiknaik, mato ol te ek' yib'anh kuk'an anh jun, xchi heb'.
